rationale: UNTUNED PLACEHOLDER. The model weights (best.pt / best.onnx) were replaced on 2026-09-04, but the validation dataset is not present on this machine (see ml/data.yaml -- it lives on Kaggle), so per-class thresholds could NOT be re-fit to the new model. Every class therefore falls back to the default 0.25. This is deliberately neutral: the previous file's tuned cutoffs (e.g. early_blight 0.825) were fitted to the OLD weights and could suppress genuine detections on the new model. To restore real, cost-asymmetric thresholds, run `python ml/tune_thresholds.py --weights ml/weights/best.pt --data <path>/data.yaml` on the machine that has the dataset and copy the resulting thresholds.json here. The prior tuned file is preserved at ml/weights/thresholds.json.old-sep2.
